Design checks
    
 
    Model notes
      

      

      Equilibrium thermochemistry is checked against NASA CEA2022 (Verification tab). Downstream models are engineering correlations: Bartz heat transfer is good to roughly 20-30 %, c* efficiency is an input, and injector spray physics and CFD-level flow are not modelled. Wall FEA, MOC nozzle, cycle balance and uncertainty analysis are in the Analysis tab. For conceptual and preliminary design only, not for flight-hardware sign-off.
      

      

      

      Performance Explorer
      

      TABLELIVEIdeal performance for chamber pressures of 5-300 bar and area ratios of 2-400, for five propellants. Values are interpolated from NASA CEA equilibrium and frozen tables (PCHIP in O/F, ln Pc and ln eps). The Verification tab compares the interpolation with fresh CEA runs. Kinetic, boundary-layer, divergence and combustion losses are not included.

      Selected operating point
      

      

      Curves use 60 O/F points and 50 area-ratio points per request. O/F is limited to the tabulated range for each propellant. Shifting-equilibrium expansion, infinite-area chamber; reactant states as in CEA (LOX 90 K, RP-1 and ethanol 298 K, cryogenic fuels at boiling point).
      

      

      Analysis workbench
      

      MOC nozzle, finite-rate kinetics, channel-wall FEA, feed-cycle balance, uncertainty/sensitivity and a V&V test suite, all run on the case defined on the Case tab. Each run records an input hash, result hash and the assumed inputs.Limitations: no hot-fire data was used for calibration. Results are for conceptual and preliminary design and are not a substitute for CFD or hardware qualification.
      

      
 

      


      
 
      
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
 
      
 
      
 
      

      


      Axisymmetric method of characteristics with a radial-flow start line. Replaces the divergence correlation; checked against the exact source-flow solution and for exit-plane mass conservation.
      
 
      


      Plane-strain Q4 model of one channel cell at the throat, chamber and peak-flux stations. Steady conduction with T-dependent k, J2 elasto-plastic pressure and thermal cycle, Manson-Halford life. Boundary loads come from the 1-D thermal march.
      
 
      


      Power balance for pressure-fed, gas-generator, expander and fuel-rich staged-combustion cycles: pump power ṁΔp/(ρη) against turbine power ṁηcpT[1−PR−(γ−1)/γ]. GG and preburner gas states come from CEA tables; efficiencies are inputs.
      
 
      
  
  
 
      
 
      


      Latin-hypercube sampling of the full model, then a quadratic response surface (checked on hold-out runs) for Sobol indices. Input scatter is taken from typical literature ranges (listed below), not calibrated to test data.
      
 
      


      Verification checks the numerics (analytic solutions, conservation, convergence). Validation compares against published engine data; the source is listed per row. Tolerances are fixed acceptance criteria.
      
 
      


      Builds one printable HTML report from the analyses run so far.
